MUSIC AND DANCE — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Western Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances-Kenyan 3.0 Critical Appreciation 3.1 Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Classical Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
